name: Nemo Stats: Laser Weapons
description:
Tunes the laser weapons' damage, heat, and spread.

Overall lasers are low durability, low penetration, fire status with infinite ammo and no recoil.

- LAS-99 Quasar Cannon
  Laser anti-tank support weapon.
  Reduced charge up time.
- R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle
  High damage precise DMR with high fire status effect and bigger ammo.
- LAS-58 Talon
  High damage precise laser hand cannon.
- LAS-16 Sickle
  Laser assault rifle with high capacity.
- LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle
  Sickle with no safety, self-damage.
- LAS-13 Trident
  Three barrels instead of one, lower RPM.
- LAS-12 Sai
  SMG variant with weaker heat economy.
- LAS-98 Laser Cannon
  Powerful laser beam support weapon with high durable damage.
  Reduces targets armor value.
- LAS-5 Scythe
  Laser beam primary weapon with low durable damage.
- LAS-7 Dagger
  Laser beam secondary weapon with low durable damage.
